title: Mark Rydell, ‘On Golden Pond’ and ‘The Rose’ Director, Dies at 97
summary: Mark Rydell, who received a best director nomination for the Oscar-winning “On Golden Pond” and directed Bette Midler in “The Rose” and “For the Boys,” died Friday. He was 97.
